title: Swarm wave 7: per-session transcript/composer retention + a11y input vocabulary

swarm.convention: GY-WAVE2-SWARM (concurrent agents, exclusive crate ownership, frozen interface contract, central integration gate)

assignments.J1: goya-zcode: SessionTranscript snapshot/restore (tail/history/streaming/scroll/tool trackers), ComposerSnapshot (text/cursor/history/draft; preedit and focus deliberately not retained), SessionRetention bounded LRU (cap 8, insertion-order eviction) owned by MonitorHandle::switch_session; restore staged via on_session_acquired + take_composer_restore so the handle never owns composer instances
assignments.J2: goya-a11y: DIG input vocabulary — A11yRole::TextInput with placeholder-in-label-slot, host-supplied live_text override (resolved_name shared by announcement and find_by_name), role-derived editable/focusable states, focus-as-activation with set_value/focus actions, traversal + hit-region parity with buttons

gate_fixes: clippy clone-on-Copy in snapshot_transcript, field-assign-after-default in a view test, two formatting passes

verification.zcode_monitor_headless: all 17 checks PASS (incl. per-session transcript/composer save/restore cycle)
verification.zcode_monitor_stdin_dump_live: link Connecting->Up, subscribed to live session

scope_honesty.retention: LRU cap 8; evicting a session drops its transcript. Preedit (live IME overlay) and composer focus are deliberately not retained.
scope_honesty.a11y: Platform vocabulary only this wave — wiring the monitor's live a11y snapshot (host feeding live_text/focused and republishing via run_with_updates) is a documented later increment.

notes: Deferred by design across waves: richer tool-call blocks (needs a UI-model design decision), proportional text/glyph metrics, system clipboard (upstream data-device), live a11y snapshot wiring.
Doctests excluded per known host rustdoc LLVM issue (README).
kaptaind auto-committed agent work incrementally (v2.12.x); gate verified the final tree via all workspace gates.
